D CORE MPO-4LC OM3 Fiber Breakout Cable for Cisco

Cisco Compatible D CORE MPO-4LC OM3 Multi-mode Fiber Optic Breakout Cable delivers reliable, high-speed connectivity designed specifically for Cisco networking devices. Made with premium OM3 multi-mode fiber, this cable supports 40G to 4×10G breakout connections, ideal for data centers, enterprise networks, and FTTH solutions. Its rugged design ensures low insertion loss and superior signal integrity, while the MPO to 4 LC duplex connectors allow easy deployment and scalability in high-density environments.

Available now at the best price in Bangladesh, get genuine Cisco-compatible quality with fast delivery and expert support from dcores.net.

Key Features:

  • Fully compatible with Cisco switches and routers
  • Supports 40G QSFP+ to 4×10G SFP+ breakout connections
  • OM3 multi-mode fiber for high-speed data transmission
  • Low insertion loss and excellent signal quality
  • MPO to 4 LC duplex connectors for easy installation
  • Durable and flexible cable jacket for indoor use
  • Ideal for data centers, enterprise, and FTTH networks
  • Available in multiple lengths to suit your setup
